source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project (IFAD-funded) - "Climate Resilient Banana Growing Technique" (ផលិតកម្មដំណាំចេកដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ), November 2018
text:
Recommended field spacing is 2 to 2.5 meters between plants and between rows, giving each plant room for its root system and canopy while keeping density high enough for good yield per hectare. Planting holes are dug in advance and filled with a mix of topsoil and compost or well-rotted manure before the sucker is set in.

Land should be laid out with drainage in mind from the start - channels between rows to carry away excess water after heavy rain - since banana's shallow root system is sensitive to prolonged waterlogging even though the crop also needs consistent moisture during growth.
